PM Modi Highlights India's Role in Restoring Southeast Asian Heritage Sites

Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Indonesia's Prambanan temple underscores India's engagement in restoring shared civilizational heritage sites in Southeast Asia. This initiative, spanning over a decade, includes significant restoration work at locations like Vietnam's Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary, a UNESCO-listed ancient Champa Kingdom site.
